description:
``data/qp-topics/spend/<run_id>-<run_attempt>.json`` — one labeling run's spend.

One record per attempt of the labeling job whose engine left an execution
file, whatever became of the batch: a run refused at the reference gate
spends as much as one that publishes and writes no labels file, so the
spend lives here rather than on the labels artifact's batch ledger. The
token counts are the engine log's, read and priced by the rule every
cell's ``usage.json`` is (:func:`fedcourtsai.usage.parse_claude_usage`,
:func:`fedcourtsai.pricing.estimate_cost_usd`), so a labeler dollar and a
cell dollar are the same dollar, and the measured spend total
(:func:`fedcourtsai.spend.measured_spend`) sums these by ``recorded_at``.

The gate figures are carried for the same reason: a refused attempt is on
file with its measured agreement, and the label seam's review hold reads
the newest gated outcome per frame (:mod:`fedcourtsai.review_hold`).

agree.description: Compared reference entries matched; null unmeasured
agree.title: Agree

batch_rows.description: Rows in the extract the labeler was handed
batch_rows.title: Batch Rows

estimated_cost_usd.description: The run's on-demand cost at `pricing.MODEL_RATES` for `model`
estimated_cost_usd.title: Estimated Cost Usd

floor.description: What a constant labeler scores on the same compared entries; null when unmeasured
floor.title: Floor

frame.description: Which labeling frame the run labeled
frame.title: Frame

label_lines.description: Label lines the run left behind
label_lines.title: Label Lines

lane.description: The spend lane this run belongs to
lane.title: Lane

model.description: The model the cost rates were applied to
model.title: Model

outcome.description: published: the batch cleared the reference gate and its labels were handed to the publish job; refused: it was measured and fell below the gate; incomplete: it was never measured (a labels file short of the batch, or a check ahead of the measurement that failed)
outcome.title: Outcome

rate.description: agree / n — agreement with the frame's reference, not accuracy; null when unmeasured or nothing was compared
rate.title: Rate

recorded_at.description: When the record was written, timezone-aware; the spend window reads it
recorded_at.title: Recorded At

run_id.description: The Actions run id of the labeling run
run_id.title: Run Id

title: QpTopicRunSpend
